$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this file, typically "https://t3.codes/schema/t3.json".

iconPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the project icon (e.g. "assets/logo.svg"). Checked before GOAT's built-in icon locations.

defaultThreadEnvMode.description: Where new threads start for this repository: "worktree" for a fresh git worktree, "local" for the current checkout. A per-project setting in GOAT overrides this; when neither is set, the global default applies.

worktreeSubmodules.description: How new worktrees populate git submodules: "recursive" (the default) initializes nested submodules too, "top-level" initializes only those declared by this repository, and "none" leaves every submodule empty for a setup script to handle. A project or environment setting in GOAT overrides this.

worktreeSparseExclude.description: Repository-relative directories that new worktrees leave out through sparse checkout, such as vendored reference code (e.g. [".repos/"]). Run "git sparse-checkout disable" in a worktree to bring them back.

name.description: Display name for the script, shown in the GOAT scripts menu.

command.description: Shell command executed in a GOAT terminal at the project root.

icon.description: Icon shown next to the script in the scripts menu. Defaults to "play".

runOnWorktreeCreate.description: When true, the script runs automatically after a worktree is created for a new thread.

runOnSettle.description: When true, the script runs in the thread's worktree each time the thread settles, for example to delete build output. Threads without their own worktree skip it.

runAsCheck.description: When true, the script runs in the thread's worktree each time a run completes, and GOAT stores its exit code beside the tests the agent reported. Threads in the shared checkout skip it unless checkInSharedCheckout is also true.

checkInSharedCheckout.description: Only for runAsCheck scripts. When true, the check also runs for threads in the project's shared checkout.

async.description: Only for runOnWorktreeCreate scripts. When true (the default), the agent starts while the script is still running. Set false to hold the agent until the script exits.

previewUrl.description: URL opened in the in-app browser preview when this script runs. Only honored on the desktop build.

autoOpenPreview.description: When true, automatically open the preview panel at `previewUrl` the moment the script starts.

items.description: A project script that team members can import into GOAT.

scripts.description: Project scripts shared with everyone who opens this repository in GOAT.

title: GOAT project file
description: Checked-in project configuration for GOAT (goat.json at the repository root). See GOAT documentation for project settings.
